propositions: Grounding finders (G1G2/E4/E6) flag symbols as missing when they exist only in prerequisite tickets, because they check only the origin/main snapshot and ignore depends_on prerequisites.

A plan citing a symbol with [rebar:<ticket-id>] syntax should be treated as verified and existing if the citation references a direct upstream dependency, but this rule exists only in prose documentation and is not implemented.

Layer-1 advisory det_citation module must parse [rebar:<id>] citations and verify edges bidirectionally (P.depends_on→C or C.blocks→P) without blocking, using injected resolve_deps callable for reverse lookups.

Layer-2 LLM agent grounding in G1G2/E4/E6 rubrics must credit citations only when a Layer-1-verified edge exists AND the reviewer confirms the cited ticket provides the specific functionality via show_ticket tool.
Fail-closed semantics: uncited, edge-unbacked, or coverage-unconfirmed citations must not suppress missing-symbol findings; reverse-lookup errors are caught and treated as unverified.
